opportunities.name: Diminuendo AP defense
opportunities.objective: Test AP as prevention through the W-selected Power Chord.
opportunities.mechanic: W chord reduces the target's physical and magic output with an AP term, while W heal/shield also scale with AP. Staff and Dawncore support AP/heal budget, Helia requires champion damage before allied healing. E helps reach the attack needed to apply the chosen chord.
opportunities.requiredState: W is last basic cast before Power Chord attack; Seraph earned and ally damaged.
opportunities.failure: Casting Q/E last changes the chord or stepping into range costs more damage than prevented.
opportunities.test: Record incoming physical/magic damage during three seconds after W chord at two AP checkpoints.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The W chord does not state reduction of true damage.

opportunities.name: Accelerando attack cycle
opportunities.objective: Trade utility slots for spell-and-attack chords after earned basic haste.
opportunities.mechanic: Power Chord follows three basic casts and Q-selected chord has a larger AP packet. Nashor and Lich Bane reward the required attack; Censer can activate on an allied W heal and boosts both users' attacks. Earned Accelerando reduces basic cooldowns up to its cap, enabling more chord opportunities.
opportunities.requiredState: Finite earned Accelerando, enough mana, Q selected last and attack range available.
opportunities.failure: Mana or exposure prevents enough casts and the attack build loses allied protection.
opportunities.test: Count chords and distinct Spellblade packets over a finite sequence at zero versus capped earned haste.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Accelerando is not free universal haste and does not directly grant ultimate haste before its cap.

ruledOut.reason: Passive caps basic haste at 60 and redirects later successful uses to remaining R cooldown.

unknowns: Chord proc classification, AP weaken caps and unresolved ultimate cooldown reduction token need live tests.

builds.name: Diminuendo AP defense
builds.summary: Test AP as prevention through the W-selected Power Chord.
builds.goal: Test AP as prevention through the W-selected Power Chord.
builds.hypothesis: W chord reduces the target's physical and magic output with an AP term, while W heal/shield also scale with AP. Staff and Dawncore support AP/heal budget, Helia requires champion damage before allied healing. E helps reach the attack needed to apply the chosen chord.
testPlan: Required state: W is last basic cast before Power Chord attack; Seraph earned and ally damaged.
Record incoming physical/magic damage during three seconds after W chord at two AP checkpoints.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Casting Q/E last changes the chord or stepping into range costs more damage than prevented.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The W chord does not state reduction of true damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Staff of Flowing Water, Dawncore, Echoes of Helia, Rabadon's Deathcap, Seraph's Embrace, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Active: Sona restores [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (0.3) × AP] Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for [3] seconds, granting allied champions [25 / 45 / 65 / 85 / 105 + (0.25) × AP] Shield for [1.5] seconds.

Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least [25 / 45 / 65 / 85 / 105] damage with this shield.

Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by [0.25 + (0.0004) × AP] for [3] seconds.

Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself [0.2 + (0.0002) × AP] Move Speed for [3] seconds, extended to up to [7] seconds if she doesn't take damage. 

Melody: Sona gains an aura for [3] seconds that grants allied champions [0.1 / 0.12 / 0.14 / 0.16 / 0.18 + (0.0002) × AP] Move Speed for [3] seconds.

Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by [0.5 + (0.0004) × AP] for [2] seconds.

Accelerando: Sona gains Accelerando stacks from using her Basic Abilities well. She gains +%i:scaleAH% [0.5] Basic Ability Haste permanently per stack, up to %i:scaleAH% [60] Basic Ability Haste. When she reaches %i:scaleAH% [60] Basic Ability Haste, instead of gaining further stacks her current Ultimate Ability's cooldown is reduced by @Spell.SonaPassive:AccelerandoUltCDR@ seconds.

Power Chord: After using [3] basic Abilities, Sona's next Attack deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=10, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage and may have an additional effect based on the song Sona last activated.
Hymn of Valor: The Attack deals @Spell.SonaQ:TotalStaccatoDamage@ magic damage instead.Aria of Perseverance: The target deals @Spell.SonaW:TotalDiminuendoWeakenPercent@ less damage for @Spell.SonaW:DiminuendoDuration@ seconds.Song of Celerity: The target is Slowed by @Spell.SonaE:TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@ for @Spell.SonaE:TempoDuration@ seconds.
